lines.en: Ami and the others wind up [[reluctantly] parting ways with me once we make it to the beach to unpack their things and figure out whether or not it’s safe to get changed into their swimsuits.
But, judging by the fact that it is freezing out and everyone else I’ve encountered is dressed in their winter clothes, this seems highly unlikely.
Oh, and also Karin had to go get into a fight with her sister or something.
I don’t know, I’m not really trying to get involved.
Kirin’s the angry one and I doubt she’d be able to ever hurt her older sister on a more than emotional level, so I’m not worried about anyone getting injured.
What I am worried about, though...
: Are you guys just going to let Yasu...talk to Yumi?
: She’s been quite well behaved as of late, so I have decided to loosen her leash and allow her wildest dreams to run free for a moment or two.
: Oh, how I wish I could don such dark clothing at this time of year!
: How do you stand so still with feet yet unsinged by the gaze of what lurks below?!
: I think it’s going pretty well.
: You two are bad friends.
: The fuck am I supposed to do about this? She’s clearly off her meds, right?
: I’ve been wondering that ever since I met her.
: I think she might just be permanently off of them.
: Do we need to like, call somebody or some shit?
: That depends on if you’re okay with using your phone now that you know I pay for it.
: Of course I’m okay with using it! It’s not like I have much of a fuckin’ choice, is it?!
: Sensei, you pay for the class bully’s phone bill?
: I feel as if this may be enabling her to a certain extent.
: He pays for mine and my sister’s as well.
: Sensei gets a lot of shit for being a perv and stuff, but he’s actually a really nice guy who’d never hurt anyone or anything.
: At the very least, you should have her perform some sort of service in exchange for such a cumbersome weight on your depressingly thin- ahem...
: On your exceedingly standard commoner wallet.
: Good idea, Touka.
: Yumi, can you-
: Fuck off! No!
: I don’t think she wants to provide any sort of service.
Which is extremely depressing as I had a good amount of them lined up for her.
I doubt she’d fit into Ami’s maid outfit, though, so I should probably take some time to-
: Yo! Quit fuckin’ thinkin’ about whatever weird shit it is you’re thinkin’ about and tell me what to do about this...thing!
: Yes, Yumi! I am just a thing!
: Unworthy to be even called a human if I’m still so weak that the threads of His choosing play hell upon my skin!
: Praise be!
: So anyway, welcome to the beach, I guess.
: Welcome to you as well, Sensei! You’re gonna be the busy one this weekend, so I hope you’re savoring this moment as much as I am.
: As true as I expect that statement to be, I’d like to know why you think I’m going to be busy.
: Because Makoto started asking everyone where you were the second she showed up.
: She’s been searching for you quite thoroughly, might I add.
: I do believe I even saw her check the men’s washroom for you. It must be incredibly urgent.
: Nah. Makoto’s just secretly a boy and really self conscious about it.
: Oh my. How insensitive of me to assume such a thing about him.
: It’s okay. I won’t say anything.
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
: Stop taking advantage of Touka’s...gullibility and clear this up before it becomes a dramatic and awkward misunderstanding.
: But it would have been so funny.
: And mean to Makoto. She like, just cleared up the whole thing about the fake relationship with a janitor you told everyone about.
: I didn’t tell everyone. Just a select few people.
: It’s not my fault you girls can’t keep secrets to yourselves.
: Oh, we certainly can.
: And on that note, I will now confirm that Makoto is a girl.
: Don’t ask me how I know how, though.
: I am quite confused right now.
: Yeah. I think you’ll find yourself getting even more confused about certain things as the weekend goes on.
: The beach trip is normally a pretty exciting string of events for us that resolves a lot of ongoing issues while introducing several more.
: How incredibly specific.
: Are you willing to confirm this, Chika? I have learned this morning to distrust every bit of information this man provides me.
: Haha...hah...
: You’re just going to have to take my word for this one, Touka.
: A-Anyway! Must be kind of weird for your first trip to the beach to be such a cold one, right?!
: You’ve never been to the beach before, Touka?
: Not one even half as...quaint as this one.
: I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume your family owns a private beach?
: A private island, actually. I’ve been taking competitive swimming lessons since I was a little girl and am quite confident when it comes to watersports.
: Ha.
: Ha?
: Don’t worry about it.
: The lower middle class certainly has the strangest sense of humor.
: But yes, Chika. It is quite strange to be coming to a place like this in the middle of what is one of the coldest winters in Kumon-mi’s recorded history.
: I’m not yet entirely accustomed to the traditions of most of you girls, but I’d like to express my concern for your well-being if you truly do intend to swim in this weather.
: I’m probably not going to bother.
: I brought my swimsuit, but...yeah. Not really trying to catch a cold.
: That is fine. I’m sure there are plenty of other ways for us to enjoy ourselves.
: You're at least going to try them on, though...right?
: Hm? What reason would there be to wear our swimsuits in weather like this? That doesn’t make any sense at all.
: But...
: But it’s the beach trip...
: Sensei, you are making it sound as if your enjoyment of this small vacation hinges entirely upon whether or not the majority of us are dressed down.
: Yes.
: Uh. My shift with this...thing is over.
: Anyone wanna take control so I can go fuckin’...walk around or some shit?
: Let us walk together! To the highest of highs! The ends of the earth!
: Let us bare it all before he who-
: Yasu!
: Yes, Touka?
: If you do not stop terrorizing that girl this instant, you are going to end up with a black eye and medical bill so extravagant that even I would not be able to handle it.
: Just kidding. That was elevated high class humor in which I say things that are untrue and then laugh when I reveal that they actually are true.
: Oh, I crack myself up.
: And on that note, I’m outta here.
: Peace.
: Mind if I tag along?
: Is that a fuckin’ joke? Course I mind.
: Get the fuck away from me, knob goblin.
: Don’t be gone too long, okay? I’d like to at least spend some time with you before the end of the weekend.
: I’m sure you will, Chika.
: I’m sure you will...
: You are quite bad at whispering, Sensei. I can hear you loud and clear.
: Yeah.
: Anyway. Let’s go, Yumi.
: The fuck do you mean, “Let’s go, Yumi?!” That’s not a thing you say!
: Let’s-
: No! I’m going somewhere alone! Fuck off!
Yumi and I make plans to go somewhere a little more private and-
: Jesus Christ, can’t I get a moment to myself around here?!
: Of course not. That completely defeats the purpose of this entire trip.
I walk down what feels like the length of the entire shoreline with Yumi, but is realistically only around half a mile.
And I technically wasn’t walking with her. I was walking behind her.
But hey, she’s finally slowed down and is now actually looking at me, so that’s a good place to start.
: The fuck are you still following me for when you’ve got an entire yacht full of girls trying to suck your dick?
: Touka has the yacht. I’m just a lowly middle class citizen trying to coax a loner into having fun this weekend.
: Oh! Well, in that case, sure! Wanna go get a popsicle and watch the sunrise together?
: Sure, Yumi. That sounds delightful.
: No it doesn’t and you fucking know it!
: I don’t even like the beach! I’m only here because Chinami kept fuckin’ bitchin’ at me to take a vacation or some shit!
: Ain’t a fuckin’ vacation if I’m gonna have to deal with you, though!
: I mean, you should have known something like this was going to happen as soon as you agreed to come.
: Ugh...At least you’re not fuckin’ zoned out this time.
: And I guess it’s technically easier talkin’ to you than it is that fuckin’ religious cult girl.
: I want to take that as a compliment, but Yasu is extraordinarily hard to talk to.
: Right? The fuck’s her deal?
: Yasu aside, can I take Chinami’s apparent forcing of you to come here as confirmation that you won’t be leaving after just a few hours again?
: I’ll be here the whole fuckin’ weekend.
: No idea how the fuck I’m gonna sleep in a room full of those other girls, but I managed during the dorm war thing, so I guess I’ll just fuckin’ chill in a corner or some shit.
: Don’t forget that I’m going to be sleeping in there, too.
: The fuck you mean you’ll be there too?!
: That was the prize for the dorm war, remember? And you guys won.
: That was real?!
: Did you think the grand prize was just a joke?
: I was sure as fuck hoping it was! I can’t sleep in the same room as you!
: If you’re worried about me assaulting you again, I think I’d sooner do it here than in a room full of a bunch of witnesses.
: Fuck you.
: We’re not at the level for you to joke about shit like that...and we probably never will be.
: I’m finally starting to feel less...scared or whatever the fuck you wanna call it around you, and it’s not gonna help if you keep pullin’ that shit.
: But, uhh...
: Shit, how do I say this?
: Even though I want you to stay away from me now...
: There...
: There...is kinda somethin’ I’ve been meaning to ask you.
: Oh my god.
: What? The fuck do you mean “Oh my god?”
: I mean you’re actually going to talk to me for once.
: This is a big moment.
: You know what?! Nevermind! I don’t need to ask you shit!
: Now run the fuck off and go hang out on your blowjob yacht with the rich girl and her culty ass friend!
: Yumi-
: No! Fuck you!
: Yumi-
: Shut up!
Pry
: Did-
: Nothing happened.
: You just said some shit about how I had to tell you and then stomped over to this fuckin’ log thing.
: But...you had that weird look thing again, so...yeah.
Leave her alone
: Did-
: Nothing happened.
: You just started walkin’ away and...I guess I kinda maybe...chased after you or something.
: But not cause I wanted to.
: Cause you had that...weird look again.
: The one that always happens when...yeah.
: I see.
: Thanks, I guess.
: It’s whatever.
: So-
: Are you going to tell me or not?
: Tell you what? Don’t know what you’re talkin’ about.
: The thing you said you wanted to ask me.
: Fuck.
: Was hopin’ your wack ass memory or whatever would have left that part out when your brain started goin’ haywire.
: You don’t have to, you know.
: I really couldn’t care less about whether or not you want me getting involved in your problems.
: Why? Cause you’re just gonna involve yourself anyway?
: No. Because I doubt I can really do anything to fix them.
: I’m just curious and want to know because it’s interesting to me.
: Well thanks for bein’ fuckin’ honest at least.
Time goes by.
I’m not sure how much, but it’s not a lot.
The wind picks up and the sun refuses to rise.
It tries to, but it’s currently stuck behind layers and layers of clouds.
I begin to manually blink as my body’s auto-pilot function and the glass panes in front of my eyes do not do enough to protect me from sand or other foreign objects.
Then, a crack in Yumi’s tough outer shell makes its presence known.
An outpouring of light leaks out of her.
: How about tomorrow?
: What about tomorrow?
: That I fuckin’...tell you or whatever.
: I don’t normally do this shit, so I’ve gotta like...figure out how.
I resist the urge to joke about whether or not it’s a confession of love because, let’s face it, even this much is kind of a breakthrough for Yumi.
One wrong move can turn that crack in her shell into the shape of a spiderweb.
Then, before long, everything will shatter and all of the light will escape at once.
And sure, I know that would make things a lot brighter for at least a short period of time.
But the slow drip of light particles seeping out otherwise is significantly more appealing to me than any sudden burst of sunshine.
: Whatever works for you.
: It’s not like I have anywhere else to be.
: Unfortunately for both of us, neither do I.
: Can’t say I like bein’ stuck with you of all people.
: I’m still better than Yasu.
: ‘Least Yasu won’t try to stick her tongue down my throat.
: I thought we weren't supposed to joke about that?
: You’re not supposed to joke about that.
: I can do whatever the fuck I want.
More time goes by.
Yumi leaves.
I don’t chase after her this time.
I figure that it’s a good move in letting her believe that she “can do whatever the fuck she wants” when I know for a fact that is false.
The only person who can do everything they want is me.
And, I guess to some extent- Maya.
But she’s too wrapped up in Maya things to exert any form of effort on that front.
Basically, those of us with an unlimited amount of time and the knowledge of such a gift may do whatever it is we desire.
Yumi may try to do whatever she wants, but she’s closer to that of an unsuspecting mother bird than a fledgling cuckoo.
She’s far too busy ignoring the things she knows in her heart to be true to make an effort to push anything else aside for her own well-being.
And yet she pushes everything aside anyway.
But why?
Oh, right.
Because that’s all she ever learned how to do.
If only I could teach her how to be more like me.
To toss other eggs outside of the nest.
And thrive in an environment you simply don’t belong in.
I have no time for such troubling thoughts.
I should be having fun.
I arrive at fun.
: Sensei! Good timing!
: Me and Io just got here and have no idea where the heck this resort thingy is supposed to be.
: It’s not really a “resort thingy.” It’s just kind of a small beach inn that we rented out a few rooms for.
: And by “we” I mean Ayane and probably Touka.
: As much as I like this, I absolutely would not pay for it.
: Do you have your own room, Sensei? Or are you going to be sleeping with the girls the whole weekend?
: If I have my own room, are you going to sneak into it in the middle of the night again?
: Mhm. So be careful when you get out of bed so you don’t wind up breaking my leg again. It just healed.
: Yeah yeah yeah. Keep it in your friggin’ pants.
: Now take us to the heckin’ beach resort inn thingy so I can eat my breakfast and listen to whatever it is Makoto’s tryin’ to tell me about.
: Is she looking for you too?
: She’s been textin’ me all morning about a stupid schedule thing.
: Apparently managin’ one stinkin’ dorm war was enough for her to make me the supreme leader of the second floor. Now I’m in charge of friggin’ everybody.
: Ya have any idea how hard it was gettin’ Io to agree to this? Your girl is tired, Sensei. So friggin’ tired.
: Well, whatever you did, I’m glad.
: I was just thinking about how I need to have more fun, and there’s certainly never a dull moment with either of you two around.
: You know what would be really fun? If we all-
: No amusement park, Io. One step at a time.
: Nevermind.
I scan the beach to see if anyone else is around and quickly find that either everyone is already here or we were just way earlier than I thought we were today.
Either way, I'm unable to find anyone and wind up showing Uta and Io the way to the inn.
Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!
